products.name: MacBook Pro 16 M3 Max Ultra Spec

specs.processor: Intel Core i9-13900H (14 Cores, 20 Threads, up to 5.4 GHz)

specs.panel: Quantum Mini-LED VA Panel with 1000R Curvature

specs.processor: Intel Core i9-14900F (24 Cores, 32 Threads, up to 5.8 GHz)

products.name: Corsair One i500 Compact Studio Workstation
products.tagline: Natural wood FSC certified aluminum casing with dual-loop liquid cooling

products.tagline: Enterprise 10G Gateway with PoE switch, NVR storage & 1.3" LCM touchscreen

specs.gateway: Full 10G Threat Management IDS/IPS throughput at 3.5+ Gbps

specs.storage: Integrated 128GB SSD + 3.5" SATA HDD Bay for NVR footage
specs.display: 1.3-inch LCM Color Touchscreen with AR switch port preview
specs.management: Full UniFi Suite (Network, Protect, Access, Talk, Connect)

products.name: Keychron Q1 Pro Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard
products.tagline: Full CNC aluminum body 75% layout with QMK/VIA programmability & Bluetooth 5.1
products.description: A refined piece of mechanical desk art. Double-gasket mount structure delivers flexible, acoustic-tuned typing with deep creamy resonance. Hot-swappable Keychron K Pro Banana tactile switches, South-facing RGB, and precision rotary encoder knob.

specs.layout: 75% ANSI / ISO with programmable rotary aluminum knob
specs.casing: 6063 CNC Machined Aluminum body with double acoustic damping silicone foam

products.tagline: 8K DPI track-on-glass optical sensor with MagSpeed electromagnetic scrolling

products.tagline: Industry-leading noise cancelation with Auto NC Optimizer & 30-hour battery
products.description: Two processors and 8 microphones deliver world-class active noise cancellation. Specially engineered 30mm carbon fiber driver unit delivers airy highs and punchy bass. Crystal clear hands-free calling with 4 beamforming microphones.

specs.nc: Integrated Processor V1 + HD Noise Canceling Processor QN1 with 8 microphones
specs.battery: Up to 30 hours battery life with NC ON, 3 min charge provides 3 hours playback
